recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the older exact Condition.verificationStatus sentence; the later FHIR-54914 wording is the current approved clarification and still explains why additional more-specific codings may accompany the required binding code.
issue_request: FHIR-19633 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request to add comments to AllergyIntolerance and Condition clinicalStatus and verificationStatus explaining that these statuses use CodeableConcept because clinical judgment may require more specificity than the required FHIR value sets allow, such as SNOMED or local coding specificity.
initial_application: Commit cccb69d8142e7ec5234dde242ca3da5d556591f5 applied FHIR-19633 to the then-authoritative AllergyIntolerance and Condition spreadsheets. Later source rework brought those comments into the current StructureDefinition XML files.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance and Condition are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-54914 later replaced the Condition.verificationStatus comment with clearer required-binding and multiple-coding wording, applied by commit 921fc1585a203f472f9650a5896e155734300777. FHIR-28458 later refined verificationStatus definitions and guidance without negating the CodeableConcept rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active source already conveys the requested rationale for all four affected status elements and no source edit is needed.
